# T004 — Establishing full frontend TypeScript checking

## Summary

The existing frontend build now runs TypeScript 5.7 semantic checking instead of `--noCheck`, before Vite bundles. No production source, module-resolution options, dependencies, lint rules, or runtime behavior changed.

## Changes

- `frontend/package.json`: changed `tsc -b --noCheck && vite build` to `tsc -b && vite build`.
- This progress note records the diagnostics and validation evidence.

## Decisions

- Before editing, `npx tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json --pretty false` and `npx tsc -b --force frontend/tsconfig.json --pretty false` both succeeded with **0 TypeScript errors and 0 TypeScript warnings**. The forced build checked independently of the incremental cache left by `--noCheck`. There were no existing type errors to repair.
- Kept the existing TypeScript 5.7 project configuration (`module: ESNext`, `moduleResolution: bundler`, `noEmit`, aliases), ESM package setting and lint configuration unchanged. A build-script-only change does not change characterized behavior, so no further characterization tests were required. Node pinning and dependency upgrades remain later tasks.

## Validation

After the manifest edit, on Linux x86_64, Node v22.23.3 / npm 10.9.9:

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `npm ci` | Passed; 900 packages installed. Four existing deprecation notices (`inflight`, `rimraf`, `glob`, `sudo-prompt`); audit reports 53 vulnerabilities (3 low, 12 moderate, 35 high, 3 critical). |
| `npm run build --if-present` | Passed; executes `tsc -b` without `--noCheck`, then Vite. Three existing CSS optimizer warnings about `display-mode`/`pointer` expressions. |
| `npm test` | Passed: 37 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, unchanged from T003. |
| `npm run lint --if-present` | Passed: 0 errors, 5 pre-existing warnings (two `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`, three `react-refresh/only-export-components`). |
| `npx tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json --pretty false` | Passed, no diagnostics. |
| `npx tsc -b --force frontend/tsconfig.json --pretty false` | Passed, no diagnostics; ensures a fresh full check irrespective of incremental state. |

## Follow-ups and risks

- Existing CSS optimizer and ESLint warnings and dependency audit findings were not suppressed or modified. Node 24 pinning and dependency remediation are separate approved tasks. Existing characterization uses offline/in-process tests and does not establish real Azure or browser behavior.
